pob.text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon[a]; he gave the vineyard to keepers[c][b]. Each man was to bring a thousand pieces of silver for its fruit.

pob.text: Flee[a], my beloved[c][b], and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
